portable_api_notes: The current FrozenTreeShap.explain accepts only train or validation partition labels and documents inherited-partition semantics. A generic external CSV must not be silently labelled validation; widen the scope explicitly in a separately reviewed copy change if needed.

Do not import the old run_week7_explainability or evaluate_week6_ensembles runner from this compact copy; those pull excluded historical modules/evidence. New CLIs should call copied library APIs directly.
Do not claim the old sealed source manifest verifies a modified distribution. This report binds the current retained source bytes; publication tooling should produce its own copy manifest.
limitations: Static dead-code tools do not prove all external public consumers. This pass deliberately favors preserving public/serialized behavior. No source edits were necessary; importing the libraries does not validate a model reload or numeric equivalence.
